# [PR #17976] [None][perf] SM120 optimizations for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4

## 正文

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Dev Engineer Review

- Enables SM120 XQA multi-block decode with FP8 KV cache.
- Fixes paged V-cache advancement for `head_dim=256`.
- Prevents output races by allowing writes only from the final CTA.
- Adds SM120 `head_dim=256` FMHA kernel enumeration for chunked prefill.
- Keeps the SM120 `lm_head` in `W4A16_NVFP4` and uses Marlin dense NVFP4.
- Preserves SM100/103 quantization behavior.
- Adds SM120 W4A16 accuracy coverage and refactors shared GSM8K test logic.
- Test-list changes use valid paths and remain scoped to the intended suites.
- No API or exported entity changes are reported.
- Reported benchmarks show improved ITL and throughput. TTFT remains unchanged.

## QA Engineer Review

- Refactors Qwen3.6 NVFP4 GSM8K execution through `_run_gsm8k`.
- Adds `TestQwen3_6_35B_A3B::test_nvfp4_w4a16`.
- Covers the new test in `tests/integration/test_lists/test-db/l0_rtx_pro_6000.yml` for CI.
- Covers the new test in `tests/integration/test_lists/qa/llm_function_core.txt` for manual QA.
- Verdict: sufficient.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Description

- Enable XQA decode multi-block for FP8 KV cache on SM120.
   - Fix XQA V-cache paging at `head_dim=256`. The page cursor advanced once per `xIter` instead of
    once per V tile which is incorrect for `headElems==256` and `cacheVTileSeqLen==32`.
   - Fix an output race in XQA multi-block mode. The merge was gated by `isLastCta` but the output
    write was not, so every CTA wrote `output[idxReq]` and the last writer won.
- Add `head_dim=256` to SM120 fmha_v2 kernels that cover `chunked_prefill=True` with FP8 KV cache.
- Keep lm_head at `W4A16_NVFP4` on SM120. Promotion to W4A4 is now conditional on
  SM100/103 and SM120 uses Marlin dense NVFP4 rather than falling back to bf16.

## Performance

| | |
|---|---|
| GPU | 1x RTX PRO 6K Blackwell 600 W | 
| Dataset | sglang `bench_serving`, `random`, `--random-range-ratio 1.0`, ISL=8000, OSL=1000 |
| Requests | warmup = BS, timed = 5 × BS |
| Server | `max_num_tokens: 8192`, chunked prefill off, `max_seq_len: 9000`, CUTEDSL MoE, piecewise graphs |

| Batch size | Median ITL before (ms) | Median ITL after (ms) | ITL Δ | tok/s Δ |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1  | 5.53  | 3.74  | **−32.3%** | **+42.9%** |
| 2  | 6.57  | 4.83  | **−26.6%** | **+30.9%** |
| 4  | 7.01  | 5.45  | **−22.2%** | **+22.0%** |
| 8  | 8.43  | 7.24  | **−14.1%** | **+11.5%** |
| 16 | 10.81 | 10.13 | **−6.3%**  | **+4.3%**  |

The win is largest at low batch and shrinks as batch grows: with 2 KV heads the non-multi-block
decode grid is `2 × B` CTAs against 188 SMs. Most SMs are active at higher concurrencies even without multi-block mode. Median TTFT is unchanged as prefill uses fused MHA, not XQA decode.

## Test Coverage

- `tests/integration/defs/accuracy/test_llm_api_pytorch.py::TestQwen3_6_35B_A3B::test_nvfp4_w4a16` adds coverage for W4A16 on sm120.
-  existing `test_nvfp4` body is refactored into a shared `_run_gsm8k` helper that both tests now call.
